import subprocess,json,shutil
from pathlib import Path
files=['crates/logex-storage/src/durability.rs','crates/logex-storage/src/native/storage.rs','crates/logex-storage/src/native/segment.rs','crates/logex-storage/src/column.rs','crates/logex-storage/src/bundle.rs']
originals={file:Path(file).read_bytes() for file in files}
try:
 subprocess.run(['python3','/tmp/logex-many-profile-setup.py'],check=True)
 result=subprocess.run(['cargo','test','-p','logex-storage','--release','--lib','--locked','--no-run','--message-format=json'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
 Path('/tmp/logex-many-profile-build.log').write_text(result.stderr)
 if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(result.stderr)
 artifacts=[json.loads(l)['executable'] for l in result.stdout.splitlines() if json.loads(l).get('executable')]
 assert len(artifacts)==1
 shutil.copy2(artifacts[0],'/tmp/logex-many-profile-tests')
finally:
 for file,data in originals.items():Path(file).write_bytes(data)
note: Three instrumented release runs per workload; nested/concurrent timings are not additive and are not acceptance benchmarks. Sources restored after compilation.
